items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 84:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the Mochin of birth? The Mochin of Hochma, called the light of Chayah, which ZA receives from Aba and Ima in the stature of AB, are the Mochin of birth, through which he gives birth to the GAR of souls. However, when he does not have these Mochin of the light of Chayah, ZA is not fit to give birth to the GAR of souls, for the aspect of essence is not drawn except from the light of Hochma. (Item 4).
